# QUANTEX

> QUANTEX is a binary options signal system: a Telegram bot (@QuantexBinaryTools_bot) with signal engines for QUOTEX, TRADOWIX and BINOLLA (OTC and Live markets), a website (https://quantexbot.pro) with accounts, documentation, billing and status, and a Developer API (https://api.quantexbot.pro/v1) that serves brokers, pairs, payouts, OHLC candles, the live signals the bot delivers and their results, future signal lists, a signal checker and the economic news calendar. JSON over HTTPS, key in "Authorization: Bearer qx_live_…". All documentation is public.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what QUANTEX is, features, brokers, plans, links
- [STUDIO.md](STUDIO.md): Q-BOT STUDIO release notes (released 18 October 2026) — features, FREE / LITE $30 / PRO $55 / ELITE $80 packages, pricing
- [guide/13-qbot-studio.md](guide/13-qbot-studio.md): Q-BOT STUDIO A → Z guide — 9-step wizard, every button, deploy, My Bots, Customize, Studio Control web app, strategies, child admin panel, run-time rules
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): how the bot, the website, the Engine Bridge and the API fit together; how a signal reaches the API; request pipeline
- [DEVELOPER_API.md](DEVELOPER_API.md): complete Developer API documentation — guide, every endpoint with parameters and example answers, error codes, plans
- [api/openapi.json](api/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the API
- [WEBSITE.md](WEBSITE.md): the website quantexbot.pro — pages, accounts, dashboard, API keys, webhooks, billing, AI support, status
- [examples/](examples/README.md): Python, Node.js, PHP and cURL examples (polling, webhooks with signature check, SSE stream, checker, future lists)

- [https://quantexbot.pro/llms.txt](https://quantexbot.pro/llms.txt): index generated by the live API

- [https://api.quantexbot.pro/v1/status](https://api.quantexbot.pro/v1/status): live status as JSON (no key)

## API endpoints

- `GET /v1/status` — status of API, data feeds, Telegram bot, payments; open incidents (no key)
- `GET /v1/account` — plan, limits, usage, key in use
- `GET /v1/usage` — requests per day and per endpoint
- `GET /v1/brokers` — brokers and feed state
- `GET /v1/pairs` — pairs of a broker: OTC/Live, category, open, payout
- `GET /v1/payouts` — current payout % of every pair
- `GET /v1/candles` — OHLC candles M1–H4 (closed candles only), activity volume, payout
- `POST /v1/checker` — WIN / LOSS / NO_DATA of a signal list with martingale steps
- `GET /v1/news` — economic events with bias, confidence and pairs to trade
- `GET /v1/signals/live` — live signals and results; cursor polling with `since`
- `GET /v1/signals/{id}` — one signal with its result
- `GET /v1/results` — settled signals of a UTC day with win rate
- `POST /v1/future` — start a future signal list (202 + job)
- `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` — job state and the future list
- `GET /v1/stream/signals` — Server-Sent Events stream of signal.created / signal.result
- `GET /v1/openapi.json` — OpenAPI 3.1 (no key)
- Webhooks — signal.created / signal.result POSTed to an HTTPS address, header `X-Quantex-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body">`
